mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a chilly 35 degrees under overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. While there is an ISS pass tonight, the clouds mean it will not be visible.

The City of Verona has released candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election. All four Aldermanic districts are on the ballot, and interested candidates must submit their paperwork by 5:00 p.m. on January 5, 2027, to the City Clerk at 111 Lincoln Street.

There is plenty to do with live music at Bailey's Run happening today, along with a 50-year craft brewing anniversary celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can check out The Crafty Fair at ART House 360 or catch more live music at Paddy Mac's.
On November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where a woman was found unresponsive in her vehicle. After gaining entry, she was arrested for O W I.
Stop by today to enjoy the delicious Snickers Swirl flavor of the day. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:30 PM tonight.
